author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Safely routes selected normalized alerts and opt-in chat to Speaker.bot through one bounded filtered queue.
changelog: 2.5.2: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.2 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.1: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.1 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.0: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.0 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.3: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.4.3 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.2: initial safe rebuild with alert-first allowlist, role-gated chat, local filtering, bounded queue, link stripping, and creator pause/resume/stop controls.

manifest.name: Voice Relay
installationSteps: Import Voice Relay, approve only Speak, and test a harmless phrase.
Review filters and event types before enabling; attach Pause/Resume/Stop only to creator controls.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall Voice Relay. It retains no spoken text history.

healthChecks.description: Confirms bounded filtered Speaker.bot dispatch is available.
